person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third-person. The authorized Chapter 1 excerpt sustains external narration across several characters, while the Goodreads evidence independently includes interior material from Chapter 15 and later scenes that similarly narrates the Zinc family, Rochelle, David, Wally, Gant, and others externally. First- and second-person forms in the sample occur in dialogue, advice, or a local message and therefore do not indicate alternate base narration. Confidence is med because Random House and Bookreporter present the same opening rather than independent coverage, and the Celsius 233 whole-book claim comes from an unfamiliar summary site that reproduces many sampled Goodreads quotes, so it is Tier D discovery material rather than credible corroboration. Audit: independent review retained THIRD, downgraded high to med, and corrected Celsius 233 from Tier C support to Tier D/none.
